reviews.intro: Real reviews from customers on Which? Trusted Traders.

items.text: Steve replaced my consumer unit and completed thorough testing and compliance of our home and outbuilding circuits. … Steve is dependable and works to a high standard. He kept me updated with progress, cleaned up each day and has a simple pricing structure. I found SMD Electrical Services' details on the Which? Trusted Trader Site and highly recommend them.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Initially called Steve to replace a light and he pointed out an electrical problem. Over 3 visits he rectified all our electrical problems. He always arrived on time and explained his work and why he was doing it. Would recommend.
items.label: Which? review

items.text: Steve undertook extensive electrical work when we moved house. The house needed new fuse boards, new sockets, new lights in the bathroom, garage rewired, fire/smoke alarms fitted. … He explained what needed to be done and why. We are very happy with the work completed and feel a lot safer knowing that an expert has tested everything. … I can highly recommend Steve.
items.label: Which? review
